derivation:
by
  simpa only [Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.cpow_neg] using Complex.inv_cpow (r : ℂ) s (by simpa [Complex.arg_ofReal_of_nonneg hr.le] using Real.pi_ne_zero.symm)
